what_seven_games_can_and_cannot_establis.binomial: P(<= 2 correct of 7 | fair coin) = 0.227; two-sided 0.453. Going 2-for-7 is an ordinary coin-flip outcome, not an anomaly.
what_seven_games_can_and_cannot_establis.conclusion: The interval spans zero by a wide margin. Seven games cannot distinguish V13 from a coin in EITHER direction. This result is not evidence the model is broken, exactly as a 5-for-7 night would not have been evidence it works. Nothing here changes the gate, the freeze, or V14's status.
